login.title: Sign in to file:Heron  -  client v{version}
login.intro: Connect to a file:Heron server. Your credentials live in your OS credential store; only the server URL is saved on disk.
login.code_help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.session_expired: Your session expired - please sign in again.
login.err_code_required: Enter your authentication or recovery code.
login.err_invalid_totp: That code is incorrect. Try again.
login.err_invalid_recovery: Recovery code is invalid or already used. Each code can only be used once.
login.err_open_main_window: Signed in OK but failed to open main window: {detail}

settings.api_token_hint: Manage or revoke this token in the web app under Account → Connected API clients.

expiry_dialog.title: Edit expiry
expiry_dialog.intro: Set a new expiry datetime, or check Never.
expiry_dialog.never_help: When checked, the share is never auto-deleted by the cron. End it manually when you're done.
expiry_dialog.err_invalid_time_body: Use 00-23 for hour and 00-59 for minute.
expiry_dialog.err_past_body: Pick a datetime in the future.

limit_dialog.title: Edit download limit
limit_dialog.intro: Cap the total downloads across all authenticated recipients. Public-link downloads have their own separate budget.
limit_dialog.unlimited_help: When checked, no per-share cap applies. The user quota and public-link cap (if any) still do.
limit_dialog.err_invalid_body: Enter a positive integer (or check Unlimited).

share_detail.copy_failed_body: Couldn't reach the clipboard. The URL is shown in the field above - copy it manually with Ctrl+C.
share_detail.end_share_confirm_body:
End this share now and delete all uploaded files? This cannot be undone.

Subject: {subject}
share_detail.discard_confirm_body: Delete the partially-downloaded data for “{name}”? You'll have to start over.
share_detail.save_all_skipped_body: {count} file(s) could not be saved because the server sent a name this system cannot use: {names}

upload.to_company: Goes to the company - everyone on the team can see it. You don't pick recipients.
upload.files_empty: (drop files here or click to browse)
upload.err_no_recipients_body: Add at least one user or group recipient, or attach an inline public link.
upload.err_invalid_time_body: Use 00-23 for hour and 00-59 for minute.
upload.err_invalid_limit_body: Download limit must be a positive integer, or blank for unlimited.
upload.err_invalid_pl_limit_body: Download limit must be a positive integer, or blank for unlimited.
upload.public_link_result_note: Public link created. Copy it below - it's also on the share's detail page.
upload.status_success: Share created and all files uploaded.
upload.status_partial: Some uploads failed - see dialogs above.

add_files.title: Add files
add_files.intro: Add more files to “{subject}”. They'll be scanned and added to the share.
add_files.notify_label: Notify recipients of the new files
add_files.status_all_failed: All uploads failed - remove or retry.
add_files.notify_failed: Files added, but recipients could not be notified.

secrets.copy_failed: The clipboard was not reachable. Select the text and copy it with Ctrl+C.
secrets.addresses_help: Each address gets its own link by email. Separate them with commas; at most 20.

empty.sent: You haven't sent a secret yet.
empty.requests_mine: You haven't asked for a secret yet.
empty.requests_asked: Nobody has asked you for a secret.

scope.per_person_help: Everyone who can read it gets the views - each member of a group too.
scope.per_recipient_help: Every person, address and the link gets the views; a group shares them, so the first member's view can use them up for the rest.
scope.total_help: The views are shared by everyone: once they are used, it is gone for all.

blockers.title: Before you can send:
blockers.too_long: The secret is longer than 10,000 characters.
blockers.label_too_long: The label is longer than {max} characters.
blockers.no_recipient_or_link: Pick a recipient, add an address, or create a link.
blockers.no_target_or_link: Pick someone to ask, add an address, or create a link.
blockers.address_invalid: “{q}” is not a valid email address.
blockers.no_limit: Set a view limit, an expiry, or both.
blockers.no_answer_limit: Set a view limit, a lifetime, or both.
blockers.views_invalid: Enter a whole number of views, at least 1.
blockers.passphrase_short: The passphrase needs at least {n} characters.

create.title: Send a secret
create.intro: A password, a key or any short text. Recipients reveal it in file:Heron; it is never put in an email, and it is destroyed once its views are used or it expires.
create.content_help: Up to 10,000 characters. Only the recipients can reveal it - not you, and not an administrator.
create.label_help: Optional. The only part shown before it is revealed, and in notifications. Don't put the secret here.
create.client_hint: You can send a secret to the people you work with.
create.link_toggle_help: A link you pass on yourself (chat, phone). Anyone who has it can open the secret, within its limits.
create.limits_help: Set a view limit, an expiry, or both. Whichever comes first ends the secret.
create.lifetime_note: Without an expiry it ends once its views are used - at the latest after {days} days (your administrator's limit).
create.passphrase_help: Optional. It becomes part of the encryption: nobody can open the secret without it, not even the server's operator - and if it is lost, the secret cannot be recovered. Tell the recipients another way (phone, chat).
create.burn_by_admin: After {n} wrong passphrases the secret is destroyed for that recipient (your administrator's rule).
create.burn_help: Per recipient. Otherwise wrong guesses are slowed down and the link is locked for a while.
create.notify_label: Notify me when it is viewed
create.notify_help: One notice per view, and one when it is used up or expires unread.
create.link_help: Pass this link on yourself. You can copy it again from the secret's page.

reveal.passphrase_help: The sender gave you this separately.
reveal.passphrase_help_burn: The sender gave you this separately. Wrong attempts left before the secret is destroyed for you: {n}.
reveal.request_passphrase_label: The passphrase you set on your request
reveal.request_passphrase_help: You chose it when you asked. Nobody else knows it, and it cannot be recovered.
reveal.last_view_warning: This is the last view. Copy the secret when it appears - once you leave this page it is gone.
reveal.destroyed: That was the last view: the secret has been destroyed. Copy it now - it will not be shown again.
reveal.no_views_left: You have no views left. Copy it now - it will not be shown again.

detail.ended_burned: Its views have been used; the secret is destroyed.
detail.ended_expired: It has expired; the secret is destroyed.
detail.ended_revoked: It was burned; the secret is destroyed.
detail.burned_for_me: Too many wrong passphrases - this secret is gone for you.
detail.not_recipient: You are no longer a recipient of this secret.
detail.no_views_left: You have used up your views.
detail.sender_note: Only the recipients can reveal it - you see who did, and when.
detail.admin_note: Administrators see a secret's status; only its recipients can reveal it.
detail.answer_to_yours: This is the answer to your request.
detail.answer_by_you: This is your answer to a request.
detail.burn_confirm: It is destroyed at once and nobody can read it any more. This can't be undone.
detail.links_help: Each address has its own link, and there may be one link you pass on yourself. Anyone holding a link can open the secret within its limits.
detail.link_unavailable: This link can't be shown again.
detail.links_recorded: Each time the links are shown, it is recorded in the secret's log.

request.intro: Ask someone for a password, a key or any short text. They type it into file:Heron, and it arrives as a secret only you can open. The first answer closes the request.
request.note_help: Shown to whoever may answer, link holders too - never put a secret here.
request.client_hint: You can ask the employees you work with.
request.link_toggle_help: A link you pass on yourself. Whoever opens it first can answer.
request.open_until_help: The first answer closes the request.
request.limits_title: How the answer may be read
request.limits_help: A view limit, a lifetime, or both. Whichever runs out first destroys the answer.
request.lifetime_help: Counted from the moment the answer arrives.
request.passphrase_help: The answer is encrypted to it: only you can open it, with this passphrase. Nobody stores it - if you lose it, the answer cannot be opened.
request.link_help: Pass this link on yourself. Whoever opens it first can answer.
request.closed_requester_unavailable: It can no longer be answered.
request.links_help: Each address has its own link, and there may be one you pass on yourself. Whoever answers first closes the request.
request.cancel_confirm: Nobody can answer it any more, and its links stop working.
request.only_requester: Only {name} will be able to open what you send.
request.only_requester_passphrase: Only {name} will be able to open what you send - with a passphrase they chose.
request.passphrase_toggle: Add a passphrase of your own (optional)
request.answer_passphrase_help: It becomes part of the encryption. Tell it to them another way - they need it as well to open the secret.
